title: Junta relevant-coordinate program
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a set of coordinates, let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$, and let $\delta\in(0,1/2]$ be a failure parameter. The program returns either no decision or a decision that the restriction is constant or that it splits on a coordinate outside $P$; it is defined by binding the low-degree junta node continuation to the junta restriction sample program, using the restricted sample count and half the failure parameter.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$
caveat: The meanings and behavior of the referenced continuation and sample-program constructions are not included, so their role can only be described at the level of how they are composed.
